_meta.note: Every quote below was copied from the cited page as re-loaded on 2026-10-01. SEC full-text search (2001+) for "Lakestar" and "Hommels" across all forms: Lakestar hits only in Oscar Health (EX-10.29, 2021) and FS MVP N-CSR (fund-of-funds holding Lakestar I LP); Hommels hits only in Facebook S-1/A (2012) and King F-1/A (2014). No hit in the Airbnb, Coinbase, Spotify or Klarna registration statements. Forbes 2017 Konrad article returned 403 and is not cited. The firm's own 2011-2013 /portfolio/<slug> pages are not on disk and web.archive.org was off limits, so Group B rests on outside sources only.

helsing.notes: No Helsing round announcement names Lakestar or Hommels. Series B 2023 (led by General Catalyst, with Saab; finsmes, siliconangle, pulse2), Series C 2024 (Sifted: 'Other investors participating are Elad Gil, Accel, Saab, Lightspeed, Plural and Greenoaks'), Series D 2025 (TechCrunch: Lightspeed, Accel, Plural, General Catalyst, Saab, BDT & MSD) and Series E 2026 (CNBC, Defense News) all leave both out. The 2021 first round is described only as 'led by Prima Materia'; no full investor list found. Helsing's own newsroom was blocked (Vercel checkpoint / 429). The independent sources disagree: TFN calls Hommels an angel, Tectonic says Lakestar came in at a ~2021 Series A. A board seat for Hommels was not confirmed. Resilience Media reports that Hommels' Oct 2025 letter dates 'his first personal defence investment' to 2017, the same year as the firm's 'from 2017' claim.
